title: Twenty-One Rubies
subtitle: Twenty-one rubies gathered among pavé, until the red reads as one field of colour.
description: Twenty-one natural rubies are gathered close among white pavé, set so near to one another that the red stops reading as separate stones and pools into a single field of colour. Each ruby was chosen by hand for its match, each seat cut by hand so the surrounding diamond light lifts the warmth rather than scattering it. The effect is deliberate — not a constellation of small stones, but one continuous saturation of red, carried in eighteen-karat white gold.
